candidate_axiom.name: Zero-Trust Dual-Boundary Demarcation & Introspectable MCP Governance
candidate_axiom.statement: All inter-subsystem capabilities and data mutations must be bounded by formal typed schemas as data boundaries (Nouns) and deterministic state automata as temporal boundaries (Verbs), exposed via introspectable Model Context Protocol (MCP) gateways and verified through ephemeral self-healing sandboxes.
candidate_axiom.operational_rule: Subsystems attempting imperative state mutation without typed schema introspection or bypassing deterministic state machine guard transitions are rejected at compile time.

metadata.exogenous_domain: Zero-Trust Formal Language Semantics & Protocol Theory (The Axioma Paradigm)
metadata.source_principle: Dual-Boundary Governance: Schemas as Nouns, Automata as Verbs via Introspectable MCP

system_profile.archetype: Zero-Trust Dual-Boundary Gateway & Self-Healing MCP Arbiter
system_profile.topology_type: Schema-Gated Gateway with State-Machine Guard Filter
system_profile.topology_diagram:
[Subsystem Mutation Intent a] ──> [MCP Schema Introspection Gateway (Nouns)]
                                           │
                                           ▼
                             [Automata State Machine Guard (Verbs)]
                                           │
                                           ▼
                             [Ephemeral Self-Healing Sandbox] ──> [Verified State Delta]

MCP Schema Introspection Gateway.role: Enforces strict GraphQL-style data graph boundaries; prohibits out-of-schema data shapes.
MCP Schema Introspection Gateway.invariant_rule: Every entity mutation must validate against declared schema AST.

Automata Temporal Guard.role: Enforces deterministic state transitions (XState automata) preventing illegal temporal operations.
Automata Temporal Guard.invariant_rule: Prohibits actions invalid in current state (e.g. charging unvalidated orders).

Self-Healing Sandbox Verifier.role: Executes proposed mutations in ephemeral test harnesses, auto-healing up to 3 compiler/test traces.
Self-Healing Sandbox Verifier.invariant_rule: Mutations failing test sandbox with non-zero exit code cannot touch persistent state.

target_behaviors.target_1_self_constructor: Binds recursive code generators inside strict schema and state boundaries (+0.0160).
target_behaviors.target_2_self_evaluator: Provides complete introspectable audit trails and zero-trust verification (+0.0155).
target_behaviors.target_3_control_group: Guarantees Byzantine nodes cannot inject arbitrary or out-of-order mutations (+0.0140).

tradeoffs.strengths: Mathematical zero-trust boundary; eliminates LLM hallucination in data shapes and state transitions.
tradeoffs.constraints: Requires formal schema definitions and state machine models for all subsystem interfaces.

leaderboard.name: Simplicial Homology Invariance & Betti Number Cycle Elimination
leaderboard.statement: Component dependency and message topologies must preserve invariant Betti numbers, enforcing beta_1 = 0 to provably eliminate circular deadlock cycles under recursive compilation.
leaderboard.operational_rule: Dependency graphs introducing non-trivial 1-cycles (deadlock loops) or disconnecting 0-simplex components are rejected at compile time.

system_profile.topology_diagram:
[Subsystem Dependency AST] ──> [Simplicial Complex Mapper]
                                             │
                                             ▼
                             [Boundary Operator Evaluator d_1]
                                             │
                                             ▼
                                 [Betti Auditor: beta_1 = 0?] ──> [Deadlock-Free Mesh]

Simplicial Complex Mapper.role: Represents subsystem interactions as an abstract simplicial complex K.

Boundary Operator Evaluator.role: Computes boundary matrices d_k to calculate homology groups H_k = ker(d_k) / im(d_k+1).
Boundary Operator Evaluator.invariant_rule: Verifies that d_k o d_k+1 = 0 holds strictly.

Betti Number Guard.role: Asserts that beta_1 = dim(H_1) = 0, proving zero circular wait dependencies exist.
Betti Number Guard.invariant_rule: Topologies with beta_1 > 0 are rejected prior to execution.

target_behaviors.target_1_self_constructor: Guarantees self-compilation terminates without dependency cycles (+0.0140).
target_behaviors.target_2_self_evaluator: Ensures hierarchical telemetry streams never feed into circular observer loops (+0.0080).
target_behaviors.target_3_control_group: Eliminates distributed deadlock in multi-leader consensus protocols (+0.0145).

tradeoffs.strengths: Mathematical proof of deadlock freedom by topological construction.
tradeoffs.constraints: Requires strict acyclic structuring; circular callbacks must be refactored into event mediators.

leaderboard.name: Far-From-Equilibrium Self-Organizing Dissipative Outlets
leaderboard.statement: Subsystems operating under high-throughput input fluxes must maintain dedicated entropy dissipation outlets to autonomously generate macro-level self-organizing execution topologies under contention.
leaderboard.operational_rule: Static closed architectures unable to continuously export execution entropy and shed transient contention are rejected.
leaderboard.principle: Self-Organization in Dissipative Structures (Derived from L0-025)

system_profile.topology_type: Open System with Active Dissipative Conduits
system_profile.topology_diagram:
[High-Flux Workload Ingress] ──> [Non-Equilibrium Core] ──> [Self-Organizing Pipeline]
                                              │
                                              ▼
                                 [Dissipative Shedding Conduit]

Flux Concurrency Regulator.role: Drives execution kernels far from static equilibrium to trigger emergent pipelining.
Flux Concurrency Regulator.invariant_rule: Maintains high continuous throughput to sustain dynamic structures.

Dissipative Shedding Conduit.role: Continuously purges stale caches, expired RPC contexts, and noisy telemetry buffers.
Dissipative Shedding Conduit.invariant_rule: Rate of entropy export must exceed internal entropy generation.

Self-Organizing Topology Arbiter.role: Autonomously re-routes message queues based on localized throughput pressure.
Self-Organizing Topology Arbiter.invariant_rule: Restructures execution stages to minimize internal transaction drag.

target_behaviors.target_1_self_constructor: Maintains peak compilation throughput during complex AST syntheses (+0.0115).
target_behaviors.target_2_self_evaluator: Prevents buffer bloating and latency spikes during high-frequency evaluation (+0.0105).
target_behaviors.target_3_control_group: Stabilizes distributed message brokers under severe network congestion (+0.0160).

tradeoffs.strengths: System thrives under high load, automatically tuning execution paths to maximize flow.
tradeoffs.constraints: Requires minimum continuous activity threshold to maintain dissipative organization.
